description: The plot titled “Hidden State Mean” illustrates the absolute mean of hidden states across model layers for three distinct conditions: “hidden state mean before gate” (dashed blue line), “hidden state mean after gate” (dotted orange line), and “hidden state mean of baseline” (solid green line). The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks at intervals of 5, indicating a linear scale representing the depth of transformer layers. The y-axis, labeled “Abs Mean,” ranges from 0 to 4.5, also on a linear scale, and quantifies the average absolute value of hidden state activations. The dashed blue line (“before gate”) starts near 0.1 at layer 0, remains relatively flat until layer 15, then rises sharply to about 0.9 at layer 20, and surges to over 4.5 by layer 22. The dotted orange line (“after gate”) stays near zero across all layers, with a slight upward trend toward layer 23, reaching approximately 0.05. The solid green line (“baseline”) remains nearly flat and close to zero throughout, averaging 0.04 as noted in the legend. The legend also reports average values across all layers: 0.71 for “before gate,” 0.05 for “after gate,” and 0.04 for “baseline,” reflecting the strong attenuation effect of the gate on hidden state magnitudes.
